description: This file defines the class HeadlinesFragment, a UI component that displays a list of news headlines and handles user interactions such as item selection. It interacts with other classes like NewsSource and NewsCategory to load articles.

classes.name: HeadlinesFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays a list of news headlines and manages user interaction with these headlines.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Initializes the list adapter and click listener, then loads default category.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets up the list adapter with context and layout.

methods.name: setOnHeadlineSelectedListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for headline selection events.

methods.name: loadCategory
methods.description: Loads headlines for a specified news category and updates the list.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Handles user clicks on headlines and notifies the listener.

methods.name: setSelectable
methods.description: Configures whether the list allows item selection.

inner_classes.name: OnHeadlineSelectedListener
inner_classes.description: Interface for a callback to be invoked when a headline is selected.

methods.name: onHeadlineSelected
methods.description: Called when a headline is selected, passing its index.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Called when the fragment becomes visible; sets adapter and loads default category.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Called to do initial creation of the fragment; initializes adapter.

methods.name: setOnHeadlineSelectedListener
methods.description: Assigns a listener to receive headline selection events.

methods.name: loadCategory
methods.description: Populates headline list based on selected news category.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Responds to user clicking a headline; notifies the registered listener.

methods.name: setSelectable
methods.description: Enables or disables list item selection mode.
